name: IQL
tagline: Implicit Q-Learning: expectile-regressed value $V$ avoids OOD actions in the bootstrap, then advantage-weighted regression extracts the policy.
diff_from_baseline: Kostrikov, Nair & Levine, 'Offline Reinforcement Learning with Implicit Q-Learning' (ICLR 2022). Avoids OOD action bootstrap by training $V$ via expectile regression on in-data $Q$, then policy is fit by advantage-weighted regression with Gaussian actor.

name: ReBRAC
tagline: TD3+BC plus per-environment-tuned BC penalties on both actor and critic targets, deeper 3x256 nets with critic LayerNorm.
diff_from_baseline: Tarasov et al., 'Revisiting the Minimalist Approach to Offline Reinforcement Learning' (NeurIPS 2023, ReBRAC). TD3+BC with extra BC penalty on the critic target's next action, deeper actor/critic, and critic LayerNorm; SOTA among minimalist offline RL on D4RL.

name: TD3+BC
tagline: Twin-Delayed DDPG with a behavior-cloning regularizer in the actor loss, balanced by $\lambda = \alpha/\overline{|Q|}$.
diff_from_baseline: Fujimoto & Gu, 'A Minimalist Approach to Offline Reinforcement Learning' (NeurIPS 2021). TD3 with a single BC regularization term; the canonical strong minimalist baseline on D4RL.
